notes: τὰ ἀγαθά σου → 'thy good things': 'thy' to σου, 'things' to the article, 'good' to the adjective. Displacement empties only the determiner slot, so the article still keeps the supplied nominal (rules 20, 102); τὰ κακά is read the same way (rule 24).
ὁμοίως → 'in like manner' headed on 'like', 'manner' being the generic completion (rules 17, 66).
